title: Can You Remember 15 Synonyms for HAPPY? (Memory Challenge)
description:
Ten words for HAPPY in a plain list, then one silly story. How many can you remember each time? Grab a pen: you get two scores.

1. Watch the list, then pause the video and write down every word you remember. That's your list score.
2. Watch the story, then pause again and write down every word you can recall, in order. That's your story score.
3. Stay for the surprise at the end, and the whole HAPPY ladder on one screen.
4. Comment your two scores: list versus story.

The story goes roughly from a little bit happy to extremely happy: content, glad, pleased, chuffed, cheerful, upbeat, joyful, delighted, thrilled, over the moon, overjoyed, on cloud nine, elated, jubilant, ecstatic. For each word, you learn what it means and when to use it: in everyday speech, at work, in polite emails, in casual chat with friends (informal; chuffed is British), or mostly in writing.

For more words, look up "another word for happy" on anotherwordfor.net: https://anotherwordfor.net/another-word-for-happy/
